forecast.generalSituationZh: 受高空擾動影響，今明兩日華南有驟雨及幾陣狂風雷暴。預料一股偏東氣流會在下週初影響廣東沿岸，該區有幾陣雨，早晚較為潮濕。而一道冷鋒會在下週中期抵達廣東沿岸，受隨後的東北季候風影響，下週後期該區轉吹偏北風，氣溫顯著下降。
forecast.generalSituationEn: Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be showers and a few squally thunderstorms over southern China today and tomorrow. An easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong early next week. There will be a few rain patches over the region. It will be relatively humid in the morning and at night. A cold front will reach the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, winds will become northerlies and temperatures will fall appreciably over the region in the latter part of next week.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，日間短暫時間有陽光。下午有幾陣驟雨，晚上驟雨增多及有幾陣狂風雷暴。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. Sunny intervals during the day. A few showers in the afternoon. Showers will increase at night with a few squally thunderstorms.
days.windZh: 東風4級，離岸5級，晚上高地間中6級。
days.windEn: East force 4, force 5 offshore, occasionally force 6 on high ground at night.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，間中有驟雨，初時雨勢頗大及有幾陣狂風雷暴。日間驟雨減少，下午部分時間有陽光。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers. Showers will be heavy with a few squally thunderstorms at first. Showers will ease off during the day. Sunny periods in the afternoon.
days.windZh: 東至東北風3至4級，初時離岸5級，高地間中6級。
days.windEn: East to northeast force 3 to 4, force 5 offshore and occasionally force 6 on high ground at first.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，日間部分時間有陽光。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. Sunny periods during the day.
days.windEn: Light winds force 2, east force 3 to 4 later.

days.weatherEn: Cloudy with a few rain patches.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，早晚有一兩陣雨，局部地區能見度較低。日間短暫時間有陽光。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches in the morning and at night, visibility relatively low in some areas. Sunny intervals during the day.
days.windZh: 東至東南風3至4級，漸轉微風2級。
days.windEn: East to southeast force 3 to 4, becoming light winds force 2.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。初時有幾陣雨。日間短暫時間有陽光，稍後氣溫顯著下降。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. A few rain patches at first. Sunny intervals during the day. Temperatures will fall appreciably later.
days.windZh: 微風2級，漸轉北至東北風3至4級，離岸5級。
days.windEn: Light winds force 2, becoming north to northeast force 3 to 4, force 5 offshore.

days.weatherZh: 短暫時間有陽光，早上稍涼。
days.weatherEn: Sunny intervals. Slightly cooler in the morning.
